great-wrap.flag: Operating entity entered voluntary administration in Sep 2025 (staff made redundant). Verify before any outreach.

visory.flag: Likely competitor/partner: markets AI-assisted bookkeeping and monthly close ('Delphi AI'). Sheet contacts belong to a US 'Visory' — not this firm.

abound-group.flag: Sheet contact/domain belonged to an unrelated real-estate company; firm website corrected to aboundgroup.com.au. Needs a new contact.

johnson-partners.flag: Sheet contacts belong to an executive-search firm (johnsonpartners.co). The Richmond accounting firm appears to be johnsonpartners.com.au (address match) — verify and find a contact.

bbb-partners.flag: Acquired by Cutcher & Neale in July 2025 (LinkedIn). Check who now owns the relationship.
